command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp
echo "== openbabel + pdbfixer: a structure-prep chain, cross-validated =="
# openbabel handles chemical perception (SMILES<->SDF, formula, InChIKey); pdbfixer repairs
# a protein structure (adds missing atoms + H); then openbabel independently reads pdbfixer's
# output and counts the H it added -- so the two tools cross-validate the repair rather than
# being two isolated checks. InChIKey is an IUPAC standard, so openbabel's must equal RDKit's
# -- a two-engine cross-check that canonical SMILES (algorithm-specific) could not give.
cat > ala2.pdb <<'EOF'
CRYST1    0.000    0.000    0.000  90.00  90.00  90.00 P 1           1
ATOM      1  N   ALA A   1       0.000   0.000   0.000  1.00  0.00           N
ATOM      2  CA  ALA A   1       1.458   0.000   0.000  1.00  0.00           C
ATOM      3  C   ALA A   1       2.009   1.420   0.000  1.00  0.00           C
ATOM      4  O   ALA A   1       1.251   2.390   0.000  1.00  0.00           O
ATOM      5  CB  ALA A   1       1.988  -0.773   1.199  1.00  0.00           C
ATOM      6  N   ALA A   2       3.332   1.560   0.000  1.00  0.00           N
ATOM      7  CA  ALA A   2       3.977   2.860   0.000  1.00  0.00           C
ATOM      8  C   ALA A   2       5.486   2.700   0.000  1.00  0.00           C
ATOM      9  O   ALA A   2       6.019   1.590   0.000  1.00  0.00           O
ATOM     10  CB  ALA A   2       3.581   3.649   1.239  1.00  0.00           C
TER
END
EOF
python3 - <<'EOF' > smoke-check.txt || { cat smoke-check.txt; exit 1; }
import sys
from openbabel import pybel
from rdkit import Chem
from pdbfixer import PDBFixer
from openmm.app import PDBFile
fail=[]
def check(l,ok,detail):
    print(f"{l:24s} {detail}")
    if not ok: fail.append(l)
smi="CC(=O)Oc1ccccc1C(=O)O"   # aspirin
m=pybel.readstring("smi",smi)
can1=m.write("can").split()[0]
can2=pybel.readstring("sdf",m.write("sdf")).write("can").split()[0]
# chemical-format decode: SMILES -> SDF -> SMILES recovers the canonical form
check("ob_smiles_roundtrip", can1==can2, f"{can1==can2}  want True (SMILES->SDF->SMILES stable)")
check("ob_formula", m.formula=="C9H8O4", f"{m.formula}  want C9H8O4")
check("ob_heavy", sum(1 for a in m.atoms if a.atomicnum>1)==13, f"{sum(1 for a in m.atoms if a.atomicnum>1)}  want 13")
# two-engine cross-check: openbabel and RDKit agree on the standardized InChIKey
ob_ik=m.write("inchikey").strip(); rd_ik=Chem.MolToInchiKey(Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi))
check("inchikey_two_engine", ob_ik==rd_ik=="BSYNRYMUTXBXSQ-UHFFFAOYSA-N", f"OB={ob_ik} RDKit={rd_ik}")
# pdbfixer repairs the heavy-atom ALA-ALA: adds the C-terminal OXT and hydrogens
fx=PDBFixer(filename="ala2.pdb"); fx.findMissingResidues(); fx.findMissingAtoms(); fx.addMissingAtoms()
heavy=sum(1 for a in fx.topology.atoms() if a.element and a.element.symbol!="H")
fx.addMissingHydrogens(7.0)
nh=sum(1 for a in fx.topology.atoms() if a.element and a.element.symbol=="H")
check("pdbfixer_heavy", heavy==11, f"{heavy}  want 11 (10 input + OXT added)")
check("pdbfixer_h_added", nh==12, f"{nh}  want 12 (H added to ALA-ALA at pH 7)")
PDBFile.writeFile(fx.topology, fx.positions, open("fixed.pdb","w"))
# chain: openbabel reads pdbfixer's repaired PDB and independently confirms the H count
obh=sum(1 for a in next(pybel.readfile("pdb","fixed.pdb")).atoms if a.atomicnum==1)
check("chain_openbabel_confirms_H", obh==nh, f"openbabel counts {obh} H  want {nh} (== pdbfixer added)")
if fail: print("FAILED: "+", ".join(fail)); sys.exit(1)
EOF
cat smoke-check.txt; echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
